facts.raw_span: remote history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma (7 years prior)
dual-chamber pacemaker implantation for sick sinus syndrome 9 months ago
fatigue, dyspnea, and cough persisted and worsened
new, painless but bothersome swelling over the pacemaker site
soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device

dual-chamber pacemaker implantation for sick sinus syndrome 9 months ago
fatigue, dyspnea, and cough persisted and worsened
new, painless but bothersome swelling over the pacemaker site

concepts.why: The patient has a history of bladder urothelial carcinoma and now presents with a soft tissue mass surrounding the pacemaker site, suggesting possible metastasis.
The patient has a history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma and now presents with a soft tissue mass surrounding the pacemaker site, suggesting possible metastasis.
The patient has a history of pacemaker implantation and now presents with a soft tissue mass surrounding the device, which could be a rare but possible sarcoma.

concepts.preferred_label: chronic inflammatory response to the pacemaker
concepts.why: The patient presents with a swelling over the pacemaker site and a soft tissue mass with increased vascularity, which could be an inflammatory response to the device.
It explains the soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device despite haematoma or infection being excluded, which may indicate a missed or atypical infection.

concepts.preferred_label: COVID-19 related pericardial or myocardial inflammation
concepts.why: It explains the persistence and worsening of fatigue, dyspnea, and cough after COVID-19 infection, which could be related to cardiac complications.

rationales.F02: Nicotine use increases the risk of various cancers, including laryngeal and bladder cancer.
rationales.F03: A history of laryngeal squamous cell carcinoma increases the likelihood of metastatic disease.
rationales.F04: A history of bladder urothelial carcinoma increases the likelihood of metastatic disease.
rationales.F05: Pacemaker implantation can lead to chronic inflammation or infection.
rationales.F06: COVID-19 infection can cause pericardial or myocardial inflammation.
rationales.F08: Swelling over the pacemaker site could indicate a variety of conditions, including infection, inflammation, or tumor growth.
rationales.F11: A soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the device is highly suggestive of a tumor, such as a sarcoma.
rationales.F12: Exclusion of haematoma or infection increases the likelihood of other conditions, such as a tumor.

frontier_selector.rationale: The presence of a soft tissue mass with increased vascularity surrounding the pacemaker site, which was confirmed by CT imaging, along with the temporal relationship to pacemaker implantation, supports this diagnosis without strong contradiction.
